description: Have you ever wondered what it takes to send a spacecraft into space? Our idea is to create a fun, interactive game where students can design and launch their own space missions while learning how real space missions work.
summary:
Introducing Liftoff 101! 

Have you ever wanted to travel through space? Liftoff 101 gives you the chance to experience space exploration firsthand. Launch rockets, explore distant planets, and complete missions. Minigames make the game more interesting.
We designed this game using Nasa pictures from the Nasa database. We also used Loveable Ai for the game itself. Our target audience are people that are interested in space travel but are confined to reading, such as elementary students.

Are you ready ?
Take control, launch your rocket, and start playing Liftoff 101 today!

Liftoff 101 – Your mission begins here.
details:
It is an app that gamifies learning about space travel .

We used Loveable and Claude for the AI platform. Most pictures except the Jupiter cloud background and landing animation were from the Nasa website. The screenshots were taken with Windows snipping tool. The idea was completely original.
